result.instructions: Kanareika: security audit results for our servers, by organization and environment (production/staging). Start with list_orgs, then get_summary. list_actions — what to fix by priority (P1 urgent … P4 background); get_host — everything about one server (packages, SSH access, ports, firewall, health, time); search_packages — where a vulnerable package or CVE is installed; fix_prompt / fix_plan — a ready task or rollback-capable fix steps for selected actions. Data is the latest known state of each host. OS packages are checked against the host's own repositories: fix_state available = update now, reboot = installed, reboot pending, vendor = no fix in the repositories yet (action cat 'vendor': mitigate or accept until available). CVEs already fixed in the installed build (package changelog) are left out of actions. All tools are read-only; scans are started by a human. Pass lang=ru for Russian texts.
